entries.title: Matthew 12:1
segments: About the same time Jesus walked through the corn-fields one Sabbath. His disciples were hungry, and began to pick some ears of wheat and eat them.

entries.title: Matthew 12:2
segments: But, when the Pharisees saw this, they said: "Look! your disciples are doing what it is not allowable to do on a Sabbath!"

entries.title: Matthew 12:3
segments: "Have not you read," replied Jesus, "what David did, when he and his companions were hungry--

entries.title: Matthew 12:4
segments: How he went into the House of God, and how they ate the consecrated bread, through it was not allowable for him or his companions to eat it, but only for the priests?

entries.title: Matthew 12:5
segments: And have not you read in the law that, on the Sabbath, the priest in the Temple break the Sabbath and yet are not guilty?

entries.title: Matthew 12:6
segments: Here, however, I tell you, there is something greater than the Temple!

entries.title: Matthew 12:7
segments: And had you learned the meaning of the words--'I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,' you would not have condemned those who are not guilty.

entries.title: Matthew 12:8
segments: For the Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath."

entries.title: Matthew 12:9
segments: Passing on, Jesus went into their Synagogue,

entries.title: Matthew 12:10
segments: And there he saw a man with a withered hand. Some people asked Jesus whether it was allowable to work a cure on the Sabbath- -so that they might have a charge to bring against him.

entries.title: Matthew 12:11
segments: But Jesus said to them: "Which of you, if he had only one sheep, and that sheep fell into a pit on the Sabbath, would not lay hold of it and pull it out?

entries.title: Matthew 12:12
segments: And how much more precious a man is than a sheep! Therefore it is allowable to do good on the Sabbath."

entries.title: Matthew 12:13
segments: Then he said to the man. "Stretch out your hand." The man stretched it out; and it had become as sound as the other.

entries.title: Matthew 12:14
segments: On coming out, the Pharisees plotted against Jesus, to put him to death.

entries.title: Matthew 12:15
segments: Jesus, however, became aware of it, and went away from that place. A number of people followed him, and he cured them all;

entries.title: Matthew 12:16
segments: but he warned them not to make him known,

entries.title: Matthew 12:17
segments: in fulfillment of these words in the Prophet Isaiah--

entries.title: Matthew 12:18
segments: 'Behold! the Servant of my Choice, My Beloved, in whom my heart delights! I will breathe my spirit upon him, And he shall announce a time of judgement to the Gentiles.

entries.title: Matthew 12:19
segments: He shall not contend, nor cry aloud, Neither shall any one hear his voice in the streets;

entries.title: Matthew 12:20
segments: A bruised reed he will not break, And a smoldering wick he will not quench, Till he has brought the judgement to a victorious issue,

entries.title: Matthew 12:21
segments: And on his name shall the Gentiles rest their hopes."

entries.title: Matthew 12:22
segments: Then some people brought to Jesus a possessed man, who was blind and dumb; and he cured him, so that the man who had been dumb both talked and saw.

entries.title: Matthew 12:23
segments: At this all the people were astounded. "Is it possible that this is the son of David?" they exclaimed.

entries.title: Matthew 12:24
segments: But the Pharisees heard of it and said: "He drives out demons only by the help of Baal-zebub the chief of the demons."

entries.title: Matthew 12:25
segments: Jesus, however, was aware of what was passing in their minds, and said to them: "Any kingdom divided against itself becomes a desolation, and any town or household divided against itself will not last.

entries.title: Matthew 12:26
segments: So, if Satan drives Satan out, he must be divided against himself; and how, then, can his kingdom last?

entries.title: Matthew 12:27
segments: And, if it is by Baal-zebub's help that I drive out demons, by whose help is it that your own sons drive them out? Therefore they shall themselves be your judges.

entries.title: Matthew 12:28
segments: But, if it is by the help of the Spirit of God that I drive out demons, then the Kingdom of God must already be upon you.

entries.title: Matthew 12:29
segments: How, again, can any one get into a strong man's house and carry off his goods, without first securing him? And not till then will he plunder his house.

entries.title: Matthew 12:30
segments: He who is not with me is against me, and he who does not help me to gather is scattering.

entries.title: Matthew 12:31
segments: Therefore, I tell you, men will be forgiven every sin and slander; but slander against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

entries.title: Matthew 12:32
segments: Whoever speaks against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in the present age, or in the age to come.

entries.title: Matthew 12:33
segments: You must assume either that both tree and fruit are good, or that both tree and fruit are worthless; since it is by it's fruits that a tree is known.

entries.title: Matthew 12:34
segments: You brood of vipers! how can you, evil as you are, say anything good? For what fills the heart will rise to the lips.

entries.title: Matthew 12:35
segments: A good man, from his good stores, produces good things; while an evil man, from his evil stores, produces evil things.

entries.title: Matthew 12:36
segments: I tell you that for every careless thing that men say, they must answer on the 'Day of Judgement.'

entries.title: Matthew 12:37
segments: For it is by your words that you will be acquitted, and by your words that you will be condemned."

entries.title: Matthew 12:38
segments: At this point, some Teachers of the Law and Pharisees interposed. "Teacher," they said, " we want to see some sign from you."

entries.title: Matthew 12:39
segments: "It is a wicked and unfaithful generation," answered Jesus, "that is asking for a sign, and no sign shall be given it except the sign of the Prophet Jonah.

entries.title: Matthew 12:40
segments: For, just as 'Jonah was inside the sea-monster three days and three nights,' so shall the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

entries.title: Matthew 12:41
segments: At the Judgement, the men of Nineveh will stand up with this generation, and will condemn it, because they repented at Jonah's proclamation; and here is more than a Jonah!

entries.title: Matthew 12:42
segments: At the Judgement the Queen of the South will rise up with the present generation, and will condemn it, because she came from the very ends of the earth to listen to the wisdom of Solomon; and here is more than a Solomon!

entries.title: Matthew 12:43
segments: No sooner does a foul spirit leave a man, than it passes through places where there is no water, in search of rest, and does not find it.

entries.title: Matthew 12:44
segments: Then it says 'I will go back to the home which I left'; but, on coming there, it finds it unoccupied, and swept, and put in order.

entries.title: Matthew 12:45
segments: Then it goes and brings with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in, and make their home there; and the last state of that man proves to be worse than the first. So, too, will it be with this wicked generation."

entries.title: Matthew 12:46
segments: While he was still speaking to the crowds, his mother and brothers were standing outside, asking to speak to him.

entries.title: Matthew 12:47
segments: Someone told him this, and Jesus replied:

entries.title: Matthew 12:48
segments: " Who is my mother? and who are my brothers?"

entries.title: Matthew 12:49
segments: Then, stretching out his hands towards his disciples, he said: "Here are my mother and my brothers!

entries.title: Matthew 12:50
segments: For any one who does the will of my Father who is in Heaven is my brother and sister and mother."
